outcome: Unsupported science now follows one durable closure path for Student and Professor research AI
owner_impact: When the intended Experiment requires semantics outside the current Lab contract, research AI preserves the whole blocked Experiment, reuses or creates the appropriate durable extension request, reports the task as blocked, and later resumes the same Experiment through whole-Experiment revalidation. Students can resume and revalidate their own blocked Experiments; Professors retain supervision access.
